description: Paid (x402, USDC on Base). Full safety report for a Base ERC-20 token contract: metadata, raw owner address, mint-selector heuristic, approximate recent-activity signal. Call without 'tx' first to receive the exact x402 payment challenge (amount, asset, payTo address, chain); pay that amount in USDC on Base, then call again with the resulting transaction hash in 'tx' to receive the real report.

tx.description: Optional: 0x-prefixed 64-hex-character Base transaction hash proving payment. Omit on the first call to see the payment challenge.

name: apecheck_report
